programme.title: Wild Tales From the Farm S1 Ep1
programme.desc: It's spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

programme.title: Wild Tales From the Farm S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that he's a friend, not a foe.

programme.title: Dogs With Extraordinary Jobs S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers.

programme.title: Dogs With Extraordinary Jobs S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa's most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries S1 Ep3
programme.desc: A look behind the scenes at the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy in Kenya and the Northern Rangelands Trust's conservation work.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S2 Ep4
